previous_messages.user: short answer only, my laptop battery is drianing very quickly, should i buy new one
previous_messages.assistant: Not necessarily. Check battery health first (capacity vs design and cycle count). If it’s badly degraded, replace; otherwise optimize power usage (dim screen, close background apps).

previous_messages.user: short answer: how to get the battery health report in windows
previous_messages.assistant: Open Command Prompt as admin, run: powercfg /batteryreport. The report is saved to C:\Users\<YourUser>\battery-report.html—open it in a browser and check Design Capacity vs Full Charge Capacity.
